generation: Existing official imagegen source reused; no new call or synthetic source painting
alphaPolicy: Preserved source alpha inside anatomical rectangle; >=128 at a single inverse nearest sample; outside zero RGBA. All outer source ink retained; proximal source cut is open and must be body-covered.
transform: Uniform .105 scale and rigid per-pose rotation about fixed root; no stretching, body shifts, inferred shape painting, independent palm relocation or geometry patches.
status: Source-derived module accepted for parent integration review after representative visual review and offscreen runtime, all-phase, source-edge and lifecycle checks; not production enabled or native OS accepted.
maskRole: Rectangular anatomical decomposition of the complete existing up-raised forearm plus palm. Three outer crop edges lie entirely in source transparency; only the source proximal cut crosses alpha, and every cut sample is covered by the canonical body at all eleven poses.

volumeBasis.note: Distal palm excludes the contiguous forearm. This is an observed volume comparison, not a claim that the original prompt produced an exact 11% palm.

fixedShoulderRole: Existing generic right socket [58.5,45.5]; no global rig or body geometry is edited. Distinct from legacy contact sampler points[0].
transitionPolicy: Eleven rigid 5-degree source poses span -20..30 degrees about the fixed socket, three gentle sweeps in the existing seven-second action, 8% shared entry/exit fade; static keypose 3 for low/reduced motion.
sourceReuse: Existing hash-bound canonical repository master and prompt are reused, not copied into this action package. Local handoff archival copies are not production dependencies.
